I independently compared the complete two-clause source lem:children (reference/SM/sm-1-polygons.tex, lines 1242–1287, with the preceding deletion-and-halves definition) to SM.children, its transparent ChildrenData definition, the actual deletion/half constructions, and the supporting proof bodies. Both original clauses are proved with their full source domains and conclusions.

Clause (i), scope and actual deletion. The first universally quantified branch uses a parent of size k+1 with k≥3, covering every source n≥4, every labelled simple flat WallGerm and every marked j. The supplied NeZero k witness is redundant. FlatAt is the printed sole critical turn support, empty remote-concurrence set, actual strict betweenness and turn SignChanges condition, on a genuine continuous interval germ with Generic punctured values. There is no extra parent G1, regular-path, guarded genericity or precomputed deletion hypothesis. deleteVertex retains every parent vertex except j in the induced cyclic order, with first j+1, last j−1 and the actual fused predecessor-to-successor edge. The already independently reviewed generic_deleteVertex proves full central Generic under these exact flat hypotheses; the proof does not merely reuse historical literature approval.

The chamber conclusion uses actual continuity of deletion, openness of the actual Generic locus and the connected small interval through zero. flat_deletion_chamber returns one delta>0 with delta≤g.radius, Generic for every deletion at |t|<delta, and membership in the genuine connected component of the central deletion. The aggregate includes both the labelled GenericTuple chamber and its actual cyclic-quotient chamber under polygonProjection. It asserts the result for the whole small interval including zero, so it includes every small t≠0 required by the source. These are geometric/topological chambers, not chirotope classes or assumed component identifiers. The representative proof of central Generic in the chamber field is the same constructed central tuple; proof irrelevance does not change its polygon or component.

Clause (ii), exact source halves and counts. The second branch quantifies every source polygon size k≥3 and simple vertex-edge germ at (M;a), and evaluates both constructed halves at the same actual centre. With d=(a−M).val, the first inherited list is M,M+1,...,a of length d+1; the second is M,a+1,...,M−1 of length k−d. Source ContactSeparated excludes precisely d=0,1,k−1,k−2. It derives k≥5 and 2≤d≤k−3, rather than imposing a new minimum or regularity premise. Therefore each child has between three and k−2 vertices, inclusively, as stated. For the source's count-only labels M=1,a=q, the sizes are q and k−q+1. Modular wraparound and the smallest permissible parent size five are covered.

Full child G1. Each child vertex is obtained by the proved injective parent-label map. Exact range calculations show the first half misses a+1 and the second misses a. Consequently no three distinct child labels can map to the parent's sole zero support {a,a+1,M}. The actual ordered child determinant is the corresponding parent determinant, which is nonzero. This proves G1 for both constructed tuples without assuming a child embedding, distinctness oracle, parent Generic or arbitrary nonzero determinant data.

Full child G2. Every ordinary child edge is an actual parent edge. The first closing cut and the second opening cut are positive subsegments of E_a. At the actual contact parameter 0<r<1, their vectors are r·edge(P,a) and (1−r)·edge(P,a), and their interior-point parent parameters are r*t and r+(1−r)*t with 0<t<1. Both are strictly between zero and one. The first half's parent-edge map is firstHalfIndex (including the closing cut mapped to a); the second is secondHalfEdgeIndex (including the opening cut mapped to a). Both maps are proved injective. Thus any three distinct child edges with a common interior point would lift to three distinct parent edge interiors at the same actual point. The inherited contact_g2 proof first derives nonzero central turns from the sole zero support and four-label separation. Two distinct central parent edge interiors that meet must therefore have remote labels: adjacent noncollinear edges meet only at their shared endpoint. Hence any full triple of parent edge interiors would be a forbidden pairwise-remote concurrence, contradicting the supplied empty concurrence set. This establishes full parent G2 and then both child G2 predicates. No central Generic/G1 or child G2 assumption is added.

Parent regularity. The aggregate explicitly concludes Regular g.center for the same parent, in addition to both Generic children and both size bounds. contact_regular derives it from the already proved nonzero central turns: each incident edge is nonzero and a negative-multiple pair would force a zero determinant. This is exactly the automatic central regularity asserted by the source, not a regular-path premise. The source's sign-change condition remains part of VertexEdgeAt even though these central child results need only its central geometric data. Labelled representatives are the exact source children, with their canonical inherited cyclic cuts; their parent-shift compatibility is independently proved and reviewed in the companion definition row.

Evidence and scope. I inspected the compiled children-types trace and its printed ChildrenData quantifiers, exact chambers, Generic predicates, natural size bounds and same-parent Regular conclusion. The 66-entry semantic-dependency hash independently recomputes to 69f94f71788e7139d4b6a464ee04ac2f940861482e961af825fb841156e6824e and matches the mapped original row. Candidate audit044 passed with stage_accepted=false. I verified receipt/stage-development byte equality, every one of 219 project and 38 frozen-bundle file hashes, the exact 213-module SM inventory, all 203 previously existing SM files unchanged, the frozen source/full trace/audit hashes, and the exact 63-file import closure below. All seven new files in this closure match the independently inspected bodies, and the 56 inherited files match this reviewer's prior source/body review evidence. The main theorem and the printed child-genericity subresult use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Successful builds and hashes support, but do not replace, this full source/type/body comparison. This signs exactly the original PROVE row lem:children, including both clauses. It does not accept an extra claim for each helper, full def:walls, a main state-sum wall law, the soft theorem or the complete stage.
